'''Comporium, Inc.''' is a local [[telephone]], [[internet]], [[Cable television|cable]] and home security provider that centrally operates in [[York County, South Carolina|York]] and [[Lancaster County, South Carolina|Lancaster]] counties in the north-central section of [[South Carolina]].  The Corporate headquarters of Comporium is located at the intersection of Black Street and Elizabeth Lane in the city of [[Rock Hill, South Carolina]], United States.<ref>[http://www.comporium.com/ Comporium - Homepage]</ref>

==History==
In 1894, John Anderson, John Cherry and Andrew Smith founded the Rock Hill Telephone Company.  E. L. and Mary Barnes bought the company in 1912; their great-grandchildren still run the company today.  
In 2001, Rock Hill Telephone Company and its affiliates became known as "Comporium," a word created from "Communications" and "Emporium"— a one-stop shop for a variety of products and services.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.comporium.com/29734/about-about-comporium-who-we-are/ |title=Comporium - About |access-date=2011-11-14 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120401150612/http://www.comporium.com/29734/about-about-comporium-who-we-are/ |archive-date=2012-04-01 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
